app_user_identifier_check.name: app_user_identifier_check
app_user_identifier_check.value: email is not null or phone is not null

app_user_sign_in_method_check.name: app_user_sign_in_method_check
app_user_sign_in_method_check.value: password_hash is not null or google_sub is not null

firmware_update_attempt_started_check.name: firmware_update_attempt_started_check
firmware_update_attempt_started_check.value: status in ('QUEUED', 'CANCELLED') or (started_at is not null and window_ends_at is not null)

firmware_update_attempt_finished_check.name: firmware_update_attempt_finished_check
firmware_update_attempt_finished_check.value: status <> 'FINISHED' or outcome is not null

outage_off_alert_due_idx.name: outage_off_alert_due_idx
outage_off_alert_due_idx.where: ended_at is null and off_alert_queued_at is null

outage_ended_check.name: outage_ended_check
outage_ended_check.value: ended_at is null or ended_at >= started_at

outage_closed_fields_check.name: outage_closed_fields_check
outage_closed_fields_check.value: (ended_at is null) = (cause is null) and (ended_at is null) = (kind is null)

outage_power_blip_check.name: outage_power_blip_check
outage_power_blip_check.value: type = 'OUTAGE' or (ended_at is not null and off_alert_due_at is null)

notification_channel_type_columns_check.name: notification_channel_type_columns_check
notification_channel_type_columns_check.value:
(type = 'TELEGRAM_PLATFORM'
          and telegram_chat_id is not null
          and num_nonnulls(telegram_bot_token_enc, webhook_url, webhook_events, webhook_secret_enc) = 0)
        or (type = 'TELEGRAM_BOT'
          and num_nonnulls(telegram_chat_id, telegram_bot_token_enc) = 2
          and num_nonnulls(webhook_url, webhook_events, webhook_secret_enc) = 0)
        or (type = 'WEBHOOK'
          and num_nonnulls(webhook_url, webhook_events, webhook_secret_enc) = 3
          and num_nonnulls(telegram_chat_id, telegram_bot_token_enc) = 0)
